notes.title: Updates Summary and little price drop ;-)
notes.content:
During last 1,5 month we did our best to fix all issues and make improvements that gamers will love.

So please check the full list below and enjoy the game! 

And yes we dropped a price a little bit so its now 4,99 tier!  

The summary:
- ːgg_instrumentsːLow energy indicator on the structures.
- ːgg_instrumentsːAbility to click on the enemies and check their stats.
- ːgg_instrumentsːMajor Balance improvements.
- ːgg_instrumentsː Localization issues - fixed 
- ːsigurdgrin1ːProgress reset - Done (Steam Achivments will stay, so get them allːsbs_collectorː )
- ːtwogunsːAI attack priority - fixed, try to cheat now ?)
-ːgg_instrumentsː Zoom revert issue - fixed 
- ːsigurdgrin1ːHotkeys - as you asked , check them out! 
- ːsigurdgrin1ːRMB Cancel - Done 
- ːgg_tentaclesːBalance on 4 and 5 levels on easy - well we decided to make it "easy" so you could advance the game ))
- ːkollerːResearch reset - done, but turned off, we have another idea how to implement it
ːgg_instrumentsːDifficulty levelːgg_instrumentsː
All casual players this is for you, we encourage you to finish the game on our new Normal and Easy levels - its supposed to be easy! If not let us know, we`ll help you! 
-If you decided to start on Hard you can continue on Normal and Easy if you stuck, and this will not reset your progress 
ːgg_instrumentsːEnemiesːgg_instrumentsː
- We added enemies count on minimap, check it out!
ːgg_instrumentsːResearchːgg_instrumentsː
We added research reset button, so you can now grab unique combination to finish the level
Steam Achievements issues - Fixed! ː2017trophyː

notes.title: Hot fix 1.03 (Update)
notes.content:
Hot Fix 1.03 is here,

ːcwd_heartːPlease check it out and let us know if something is not rightːcwd_heartː,

ːgg_instrumentsːDifficulty levelːgg_instrumentsː

All casual players this is for you,  we encourage you to finish the game on our new Normal level - its supposed to be easy!  If not let us know, we`ll help you!        

-We received a lots of feedbacks about "casual"  difficulty,  and now easy level - is normal (but its still easy) 

-If you decided to start on Hard  you can can continue on Normal if you stuck, and this will not reset your progress 

ːgg_instrumentsːEnemiesːgg_instrumentsː

- We added enemies count on minimap, check it out!

ːgg_instrumentsːResearchːgg_instrumentsː

We added research reset button,  so you can now grab unique combination to finish the level
